name: Future Tech — Auto-Media Profile-Driven n8n Template

parameters.jsCode:
const trigger=$("Auto-Media Trigger").first().json; const input=trigger.body ?? trigger; const config=input.config||{}; const baseUrl=String(config.aiBaseUrl||"").replace(/\/+$/,""); const stories=$("Build Prompt").all();
return $input.all().map((item,i)=>{const raw=String(((item.json.choices||[])[0]||{}).message?.content||"").trim();let post={};try{const m=raw.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);post=JSON.parse(m?m[0]:raw);}catch{} const story=(stories[i]||{}).json||{};return {json:{...item.json,baseUrl,requestBody:{model:String(config.aiTextModel||"auto"),temperature:Number(config.aiTemperature||0.85),messages:[{role:"system",content:"Create a concise ready-to-use photorealistic editorial image prompt for this news story. No headline text, fake UI text, watermarks or random numbers. Return JSON only with key image_prompt."},{role:"user",content:["Headline: "+(post.headline||story.title||""),"Post: "+(post.post||""),"Summary: "+(story.summary||"")].join("\n\n")}]}};});

const response=$json?.body??$json; const first=Array.isArray(response?.data)?response.data[0]:null; if(!first) throw new Error("Image provider returned no image data."); let b64=first.b64_json; if(!b64&&typeof first.url==="string"&&first.url.startsWith("data:")){const comma=first.url.indexOf(",");if(comma>=0)b64=first.url.slice(comma+1);} if(!b64) throw new Error("Image response has no b64_json data."); const mimeType=first.mime_type||"image/png"; const ext=mimeType.includes("jpeg")||mimeType.includes("jpg")?"jpg":mimeType.includes("webp")?"webp":"png"; const binary=await this.helpers.prepareBinaryData(Buffer.from(b64,"base64"),"generated-image."+ext,mimeType); return [{json:{$("Format Output").first().json,imageMimeType:mimeType,imageExtension:ext},binary:{data:binary}}];
